clue.text: "Queen in Noisy Sex Session" proves to be non-genuine article

parts.note: F stands for forte, the musical instruction to play loudly

indicators.note: in says the royal letters sit inside the session word

parts.note: an orgy is a session of group sex
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the usual abbreviation for the Queen

explanation.surface: A tabloid headline about a royal scandal turns out to be a fake.
explanation.walkthrough: The quotation marks dress the clue as a tabloid headline; 'Noisy' is the musical forte, not a description of the session.
explanation.definitionFit: A forgery is a counterfeit item made to pass as the real thing.

clue.text: Island, a pale one, has ultimate punch-up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up says the whole string is read from the bottom

parts.note: wan means pale
I is the Roman numeral for one
KO, a knockout, is the final blow in a boxing match

explanation.surface: An island where a sickly visitor ends up in a fistfight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'punch-up' looks like one word for a fight, but 'up' does its own job, turning the whole string over in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Okinawa is a Japanese island south of the main islands.

clue.text: Pot snooker ball first in lyricist's emblem of home?

indicators.note: first says the ball word comes before the drug word

parts.note: the green is one of the coloured balls in snooker
pot and grass are both slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: Sinking a snooker ball before anything else.
explanation.walkthrough: Pot looks like the snooker verb, but it is cannabis. The definition refers to the song 'Green, Green Grass of Home', whose lyricist made the lawn stand for home.
explanation.definitionFit: In the famous song, the lawn of the singer's old house is the image he dreams of as home.

clue.text: Type of prolapse keeping one at the concert?

indicators.note: keeping says the medical word holds the numeral inside it

parts.note: a rectal prolapse is a common medical kind of prolapse
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A medical emergency striking someone in the audience at a concert.
explanation.definitionFit: A recital is a musical performance, typically by a soloist, so a kind of concert.

clue.text: Returning from rocky fissure, exert cultural influence

indicators.note: Returning says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A climber coming back out of a crack in the rock to spread their culture.
explanation.definitionFit: To Russify is to impose Russian language and culture on a people.

clue.text: Queuing endlessly, misguidedly — there's no match!

indicators.note: misguidedly says the remaining letters are put in the wrong order
endlessly says the final letter of the queuing word is dropped

explanation.surface: A complaint about people forming a muddled, never-ending queue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' drops G from QUEUING, and 'misguidedly' rearranges QUEUIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unique has no equal anywhere, nothing to match it.

clue.text: Ship carrying present to soldiers on board in adverse weather

indicators.note: carrying says the ship holds the time word inside it

parts.note: SS, steamship, is the usual abbreviation for a ship
now means the present time
the Royal Marines, RM, are soldiers serving aboard ships

explanation.surface: A ship ferrying a gift to troops at sea runs into bad weather.
explanation.definitionFit: A snowstorm is a heavy fall of snow with wind, plainly harsh weather.

clue.text: Citizen's brother given enema mistakenly

definitions.note: the definition reads as 'citizen is', the 's linking it to the wordplay

parts.note: Fr, Frater, abbreviates brother as a religious title

indicators.note: mistakenly says these letters are put in the wrong order

explanation.surface: A man's brother is given an enema by mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: A freeman is a citizen with full rights, especially of a city.

clue.text: Old 3 upset by gas choking American's sensitive area

indicators.note: upset says the old letter and the colour word are jumbled together

parts.note: the answer to 3 down begins with the snooker ball colour, giving this word

indicators.note: choking says the gas holds the American letters inside it

parts.note: ozone is a gas, a form of oxygen
US is the abbreviation for American

explanation.surface: An elderly person upset by fumes affecting an American's tender spot.
explanation.walkthrough: '3' means GREEN, the first word of 3 down; 'upset' rearranges O GREEN into EROGEN.
explanation.definitionFit: An erogenous zone is a part of the body particularly sensitive to sexual stimulation.

clue.text: Deputy's bad habit

definitions.meaning: ...- as in ...-president means deputy, the 's linking to the second sense
a moral failing or bad habit

explanation.surface: The assistant's weakness.
explanation.definitionFit: Vice as a prefix means deputy, and as a noun it means a wicked habit.

clue.text: Wanting a cigar, one can perhaps be at risk from this

definitions.text: Wanting a cigar, one can perhaps be at risk from this

indicators.note: wanting means lacking, so the clue's 'a' is removed from the pool
perhaps hints that the remaining letters can be rearranged

explanation.surface: Craving a cigar means risking the thing in its smoke that causes cancer.
explanation.walkthrough: Take CIGAR ONE CAN, remove an A, and rearrange the rest; the whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A carcinogen is a cancer-causing substance, like those in cigar smoke.

clue.text: Understand about girl being big eater

indicators.note: about says the understanding word goes round the name

parts.note: get means understand, as in I get it
Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Grasping that a girl has a huge appetite.
explanation.definitionFit: A gannet is a seabird, and figuratively a greedy person who eats a lot.

clue.text: Regrets entering game with setter — not a pretty sight!

definitions.note: the phrase describes something horrible to look at, an adjective sense

indicators.note: entering says the regret word goes inside the game word

parts.note: Go is a Japanese board game
rues means regrets
the setter refers to themselves as me

explanation.surface: The setter regrets joining a game, which turned out ugly.
explanation.definitionFit: Gruesome means horrid and repellent to see.

clue.text: Temporary bridge for doctor on horseback wanting body

indicators.note: on says the doctor comes after the horse piece in this across entry

parts.note: a horse is a nag, and that word turned back gives these letters
GP is a general practitioner, a family doctor
lank, meaning lean, describes a frame lacking flesh

explanation.surface: A temporary crossing for a doctor riding who has no body.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horseback' looks like riding, but it reads as horse (NAG) back, so GAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A gangplank is a movable board used as a walkway onto a ship.

clue.text: Sex cell, thus divided, offers resistance to fuel tank

indicators.note: divided says the cell word is split by the thus word

parts.note: a gamete is a sex cell
so means thus
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A biology note on how a dividing cell resists a fuel tank.
explanation.definitionFit: A gasometer is a large tank for storing town gas, a fuel.

clue.text: Indicate purpose

definitions.meaning: to direct attention with a finger
the aim or reason, as in what is the use

explanation.surface: Show the aim.
explanation.definitionFit: To point is to indicate, and the point of something is its purpose.

clue.text: See 3
Creature managed to consume 202 onion heads?

indicators.note: to consume says the managed word swallows the other letters

parts.note: ran means managed, as in ran a business
CC is Roman 200, and two heads of onion are OO

explanation.surface: An animal that got through two hundred onions.
explanation.walkthrough: '202' splits as 200 (CC) plus two, the two applying to 'onion heads': two Os.
explanation.definitionFit: A raccoon is a North American mammal with a masked face, an example of a creature.

clue.text: Heart of 5 replacing 5 in drunken Muscovite tailor

indicators.note: drunken says the letters stagger into a new order
replacing says one letter is swapped in for another

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five

indicators.note: heart of picks the middle letter of the answer to 5 across

parts.note: the answer to 5 across

explanation.surface: A drunk Russian tailor making alterations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heart of 5' is S, the middle of RUSSIFY; it replaces V (Roman 5) in MUSCOVITE, and 'drunken' rearranges MUSCOSITE.
explanation.definitionFit: To tailor is to adapt to a particular need, the same as to customise.

clue.text: Worth getting up to catch beginning of reveille on oriental boat

indicators.note: to catch says the worth word holds the letter
in a down clue, getting up says the letters are read from the bottom

parts.note: merit means worth

indicators.note: beginning of picks the first letter of reveille

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for east, oriental

explanation.surface: Someone worthy rising early at reveille aboard an eastern vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: MERIT catches R to give MERIRT, which 'getting up' turns into TRIREM.
explanation.definitionFit: A trireme was an ancient galley with three banks of oars, a type of boat.

clue.text: Don't change boy's hat

parts.note: stet is the proofreader's instruction to leave text as it was
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: Keep the boy's hat as it is.
explanation.definitionFit: A Stetson is a wide-brimmed cowboy hat.

clue.text: Simple matter, holding trainee in embrace

indicators.note: holding says the easy word holds the trainee letter

parts.note: a cinch is something very easy
L, for learner, marks a trainee driver

explanation.surface: Hugging a trainee is easy.
explanation.definitionFit: A clinch is a tight embrace, as with lovers or boxers.

clue.text: Sentimental guff — that's whisky-drinking frequency measure

parts.note: sc., scilicet, means that is

indicators.note: drinking says the frequency unit swallows the whisky word

parts.note: Hz, hertz, is the unit of frequency
malt is a kind of whisky

explanation.surface: Gushing nonsense about how often someone drinks whisky.
explanation.definitionFit: Schmaltz is excessive sentimentality in art or music.

clue.text: Shed wants to devour Gordius's heart for sure

parts.note: Shed is the setter, who in a clue is I

indicators.note: to devour says the setter's words swallow the letter

parts.note: need means wants

indicators.note: heart picks the middle letter of the other setter's name

explanation.surface: One setter wants to eat another setter's heart.
explanation.walkthrough: Gordius is another Guardian setter; D sits in the middle of his pseudonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Indeed means certainly, the same as for sure.

clue.text: Aristocratic twin catching cold

indicators.note: catching says the twin word holds the cold letter

parts.note: dual means twin, double
C stands for cold on taps

explanation.surface: A noble's twin brother has caught a cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Ducal means relating to a duke, so aristocratic.

clue.text: Many formerly pierced by spike with 16 showing self-control

parts.note: C is Roman 100, many

indicators.note: pierced by says the spike goes into the first pieces

parts.note: once means formerly
a tine is a prong or spike
the answer to 16 across, here a compass point, N

explanation.surface: Lots of things once were stabbed by a spike, showing restraint.
explanation.walkthrough: '16' is POINT, a compass point, so N.
explanation.definitionFit: Continence is restraint, especially over one's appetites.

clue.text: Horn or clarinet's first 6 29 16

indicators.note: first picks the opening letter of the clarinet and of the three other answers

explanation.surface: Choosing between a horn and a clarinet in a list of numbers.
explanation.walkthrough: 6, 29 and 16 point at those answers; their first letters follow C.
explanation.definitionFit: A cusp is a pointed end, as each horn of a crescent moon.

clue.text: Where chaos reigns supreme in a state

definitions.text: Where chaos reigns supreme in a state

parts.words: Where chaos reigns supreme in a state
parts.note: describes a country in which no ruler governs and disorder takes over, with reigns playing on rule

explanation.definitionFit: Anarchy is lawless disorder from the absence of government.

clue.text: Support protecting railroad from commercial pressure

indicators.note: protecting says the support goes round the railroad

parts.note: a sling supports an injured arm
El is the American elevated railroad

explanation.surface: Support shielding the railway from business demands.
explanation.definitionFit: Selling, as in hard selling, is pressure to buy.
